response.sql: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT AVG(test_count) AS average_count, SUM(test_count) AS total_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT s.sex, s.test_count, CAST(s.test_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS fraction_of_total, s.test_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM sex_counts AS s CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE s.test_count > t.average_count
